purpose: A stack of collapsible sections that share one look, for FAQs and settings where people open only what they need. Items open and close independently; the first is open by default.

notFor.case: Switching between views where only one shows at a time.
Content that must always be visible.

Default.meaning: The stack itself has no state; each item opens and closes.
Default.visual: Items stacked 0 apart (ghost-default, ghost-underline, card) or 8 apart (the other variants). card frames the stack: Surface/layer-2, a 1px Border/default edge, Radius/container, clipped; the last item drops its rule.

a11y.role: none on the root; each trigger is a button in a heading with aria-expanded
a11y.keyboard: Each trigger is in the tab order. Space or Enter toggles the focused section; Arrow Down / Up move to the next / previous trigger; Home / End to the first / last (Radix Accordion).

openQuestions: Only independent opening (type multiple) is offered. Is a one-open-at-a-time mode needed?
